nit: after this change the header no longer contains any discovery code — just SensorConfigs, the shared constants, and the forward decls. The "DeviceDiscovery" name is now stale. Worth a follow-up to rename it to something like NvidiaSensorConfig.hpp.

Agreed — after centralizing the discovery code, this header is just a leftover. Renamed it to NvidiaSensorConfig.hpp (only SensorConfigs + the shared constants) and trimmed its includes in this patch set.
Should we move this to `DeviceManager.hpp` as well?

Thanks! I'd rather not move SensorConfigs into DeviceManager.hpp — As Eric suggested, the cleaner fix is to rename this now-stale header to something lightweight like NvidiaSensorConfig.hpp (just SensorConfigs + the shared constants). I'll do that rename in a follow-up patch to keep this change focused on the centralization refactor.

These looked duplicated with what `DeviceManager.hpp` has defined. 
Please consider remove these.
